$comment: Single source of truth for every moltek theme. Read by scripts/themes.mjs,
which gates the contrast and generates src/app/themes.generated.css. Do not
hand-edit the generated CSS, and do not duplicate these values anywhere:
a palette defined twice is a palette that drifts.
Only tokens the gate can measure live here. Everything decorative (the
neutral ramp, the booth, the room, the LEDs, the syntax colours) derives
from bg/fg/accent with color-mix in the generated CSS, so it follows the
theme automatically and inverts correctly for a light one.

themes.name: ember
themes.label: ember
themes.note: The default. Slate room, one warm accent, a glow rather than daylight.

themes.name: concrete
themes.label: concrete
themes.note: Grey room, the equipment carries the colour. The booth look.

themes.name: sodium
themes.label: sodium
themes.note: Street lighting at 4am. Warmest of the set, and the highest headroom.

themes.name: steel
themes.label: steel
themes.note: Cold industrial. Calmest of the dark set, reads studio more than club.

themes.name: hazard
themes.label: hazard
themes.note: Signage orange on near-black. Loudest dark theme.

themes.name: oxblood
themes.label: oxblood
themes.note: Deep red room. The accent is the red, so record has to go the other way.

themes.name: bone
themes.label: bone
themes.note: The one light theme. Proves the tokens work rather than just recolouring a dark room.
